items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: a man that had been with the Chick Webb band

ctx.x: Bobby, a singer to end all singers. Oh I’ve been with him full time for four and a half years. I replaced a guy named Beverly Peer, a man that had been with the Chick Webb band. He was 84 when he resigned, in the middle of a night. He couldn’t get through the second set. He was very ill and Bobby called me up and Bobby said, “What are you doing?” I had rehearsed with him that day and the day before. Rehearsed the show. Because that Beverly was on the brink. And Bobby called me at nine o’clock and says, “What are…
Does he go from coast — or from Europe?
